verdict.rationale: Rainforest provides configurable, embeddable components (payment component, merchant onboarding component) and a Component Studio for white-labeling, plus API/webhook access to underlying data (deposits, splits, merchant billing profiles) that a platform could surface under its own brand [rainforest-docs-4][rainforest-docs-11][rainforest-docs-19][rainforest-docs-39][rainforest-docs-7]. The marketing page also references pre-built embeddable components for 'reporting' alongside payments and onboarding, implying transaction history/balance surfaces exist [rainforest-docs-15], and platforms retain and can export their own payment/merchant data [rainforest-docs-34]. However, there is no dedicated documentation page or API reference specifically describing a balances/payouts/transaction-history component or endpoint, only a general mention of 'reporting' components. Missing for 10: explicit docs/API reference for a balances component, a payouts history component, and a transaction-history component with white-label styling details.
